snippet.title: Stonestorm | Official Trailer | Free Idle MMORPG, 31 October
snippet.description:
Three kingdoms. Four classes. One storm.
Stonestorm is a free idle MMORPG you can play in your browser on PC or on your phone. Hunt storm stones, forge your gear to +9, raise a guild and fight for your kingdom.

🗓️ Gates open: 31 October, 18:00 CET
🎁 Pre-register for the free Founder's Gift: https://stonestorm.gg
💬 Join the community: https://discord.gg/stonestorm

Follow us:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/stonestormgg
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/stonestormgg
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@stonestormgg

Footage may change before launch.

#Stonestorm #MMORPG #IdleGame
